numbering_policy: Original Saints references, chapters, reading sections, anchors and continuation bodies are preserved. Missing original verse numbers are not filled from another edition.
review_notes: All 112 actual original John source units in chapters 1–3 were read with their complete local scenes: 51 in chapter 1, 25 in chapter 2 and 36 in chapter 3. There are 102 proposed paired sources, 105 pairs and 10 explicit deferrals.

Every retained target was read in the exact pinned Saints cache with relevant surrounding context. Source and target wording, original divisions, IDs, gaps and continuation bodies are preserved. The proposals do not establish new critical-text approval or replace the source's provisional editorial status.

The syntax crossing John 1:3–4 remains intact: the final words of 1:3 continue into 1:4. Comparisons do not substitute the familiar alternative division or silently normalize the supplied grace-in-place-of-grace and only-begotten-God wording.

Creation, incarnation, divine childhood and Father-Son revelation comparisons identify actual shared clauses while preserving each passage's distinct vocabulary. They are passage relationships, not a new harmonized paraphrase or a fresh systematic doctrinal ruling.

Baptist testimony comparisons distinguish witnesses, speakers, vision descriptions, the Spirit's remaining in John versus Mark's into wording, and Spirit baptism versus Matthew's additional fire. John's Elijah denial is retained alongside Luke's spirit-and-power description rather than rewritten.

The title Prophet is compared with Deuteronomy as background, and Isaiah 40:3 is a named quotation. Genesis 28:12 supplies the angels' ascending-and-descending pattern without adding a literal ladder to John's plural promise. Psalms use the exact Greek-OT IDs 31:2, 2:6–7 and 68:10.

Calling and recognition accounts retain different participants and occasions. Cephas/Peter and son-of-John versus Bar-Jonah are not silently harmonized. Philip's son-of-Joseph wording remains reported speech, and perceived-origin objections remain characters' claims rather than endorsed geographic conclusions.

Internal references expressly mark repeated testimony, translated forms of address, a later participant identification, recalled location or sign, clarification of baptismal agency, and recurring teaching. They are not additional independent witnesses or extra events.

Cana comparisons preserve the actual mother, servants, feast-master, bridegroom, vessels and differing kinds of provision. The servants' knowing is not made a statement that no one else knows. The beginning/second-sign notices do not remove the intervening Jerusalem signs reported by the same Gospel.

Temple accounts retain different narrative placements, action lists and interpretations of God's house. The supplied Psalm 68:10 past expression and John's future citation are distinguished. Mark's false-witness allegation is not substituted for Jesus' Destroy-this-sanctuary saying or its stated bodily explanation.

Nicodemus comparisons distinguish divine birth from his physical-womb objection. Ezekiel's water/new-Spirit promise is qualified background, not an asserted direct quotation or a complete ruling on ritual interpretation. Ecclesiastes' spirit and womb imagery is read as supplied beside John's wind/Spirit illustration.

Wisdom of Solomon 9:16–17 supplies the verified earthly/heavenly knowledge contrast and the Holy Spirit from on high. Numbers 21:8–9 supplies the explicit lifted-serpent episode, with physical looking-and-living distinguished from John's ensuing belief-and-eternal-life application.

Saving-purpose and judgment statements are compared together without deleting either. Rejection formulas are kept alongside the text's explicit receivers, and believing, disobeying, having the Son and receiving testimony keep their respective verbs. No fixed afterlife geography or universal failure of every sign-believer is inferred.

Pronouns and speech boundaries follow the supplied edition: the we/you-all testimony formula is not reassigned to a speculative set of speakers, and John 3:31–36 is not newly attributed across the source's unquoted boundary.

Target IDs, original-contiguous ranges, exact source coverage, unique directed pairs and exclusion of self targets are checked before handoff. This is English passage review rather than an exhaustive concordance, independent human specialist approval or live destination-anchor verification.

Read all100 original source units in John4–5 after the recorded completion of all1149 Luke source units. Read every retained actual target passage with surrounding context; reused targets were not credited as new source reviews.

John5:4 is absent in the original and remains absent. The stirred-water statement in5:7 is not supplemented by an angel account. John8:11 retains its actual closing bracket as target evidence; no new critical-text judgment is claimed.

Psalm121 and Nehemiah and all other source divisions follow the Saints Greek-based inventory. Narrative comparisons retain the distinct royal official/son, centurion/slave, Jairus/daughter and separate Sabbath patients.
Internal references and contrasts are labeled as such, not offered as independent testimony. Named sites and unnamed witnesses are not assigned unsupported identities.
This is supplied-English passage comparison, without new Greek/Hebrew apparatus verification, exhaustive concordance or independent human specialist approval.

The full 878-unit John source inventory was prepared with zero completion credit after all original Luke units were read. Only individually reviewed source units with supported retained connections earn completion credit.
interpretation_scope: Connections are individually labelled; thematic or internal links do not establish identical events or independent testimony.
source_limitations: NA28 is the user-authorized provisional New Testament base. Focused checks of the German Bible Society’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not complete critical-text or apparatus verification. The newer Bespoke PDF’s preferred UBS6 text has not been obtained; UBS6/ECM comparison, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
